field_comparison.identity_and_shape: Both documents define one mandatory alphanumeric character.
field_comparison.november_2013_description: Y means the item number changed; N means the item number has not changed.
field_comparison.february_2022_description: Y means there has been a change to the item; N means no changes to the item.
field_comparison.finding: The official documentary wording broadens between the two editions; the precise operational meaning and effective release boundary are not established by these documents alone.
